details: Generated ASCII and binary DIMENSION frames independently toggle group-70 bit 128 while retaining subtype and bit 32.
Low-level wire checks assert group-70 values before parseback for standard linear, aligned, angular, and ordinate dimensions.
Typed parseback retains the expected flags and group-11 OCS midpoint; a following LINE sentinel checks record continuity.
Generated output DXFs receive the same wire checks before their readback assertions.

A source-generated common DWG dimension-base control independently reads the emitted Flags 1 RC for AC1018, AC1021, and AC1024, checking DXF bit-128 inversion and bit-32 preservation across linear, aligned, and ordinate subtype values.

notEstablished: The DWG control reads and asserts the emitted common-base Flags 1 field; it is not a complete DWG reader round-trip or native CAD qualification.
No production parser/writer behavior or broad DWG/DXF support claim changed.
No external drawing fixture, dependency, or CTest registration was added.
